note: Adapted from Ahmad 1965, Termites (Isoptera) of Thailand (Bull. Amer. Mus. Nat. Hist. 131), originally in English. The original describes the soldier only: the holotype and the paratypes are soldiers, and the measurements follow the table of five soldiers; no worker or alate description was found. Type locality Prew (Thailand), dug out of the ground by M. Ahmad on 28/3/1962. OCR problems: the two-column layout of the book is interrupted by TABLE 43 (the six-soldier measurement table of the preceding subspecies, M. concaveus) and TABLE 44 (the five-soldier table of this species), so that the word broken mid-sentence as "anterolateral cor-" and "ners produced" after the table lie on either side of it and have been joined here according to the sense; the genus is printed as "Microcapritermes" in the table heading (a misspelling in the original); the row labels of the two tables and the holotype/range/mean values were split into two separate stretches by the OCR and have been matched row by row in row order.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closely related to Mirocapritermes connectens, from which it differs in: larger size; the frontal projection more prominent and more broadly rounded; the labrum more deeply concave. M. valeriae is distinctly larger; M. latignathus has shorter and broader mandibles; M. concaveus has a wider labral notch and the anterolateral corners incurved.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head pale yellow, labrum milky white, mandibles pale red-brown, antennae pale yellow tinged with brown, thorax, legs and abdomen yellowish white. Head capsule with numerous hairs, those on the frontal projection denser than on the rest of the head capsule; labrum with 4 long setae near the apex; pronotum sparsely haired. Head rectangular, less than 1.5× as long as wide; the median suture visible but not very distinct; the frontal projection broadly rounded in profile. Anterior margin of the labrum with a deep V-shaped notch, the anterolateral corners produced. Mandibles slightly asymmetrical: the left mandible curved at its middle, the apex hooked; the right mandible blade-like. Postmentum moderately arched, its narrowest point towards the posterior margin rather than at the widest part. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 not distinctly longer than segment 3, segment 4 the shortest. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave, the posterior margin without a notch.
Measurements (5 soldiers, mm; holotype/range/mean): head length to the tip of the frontal projection 1.06/1.01—1.14/1.07; head width 0.80/0.75—0.83/0.79; head height 0.72/0.70—0.78/0.72; left mandible length 1.14/1.09—1.14/1.12; right mandible length 1.11/1.06—1.14/1.09; postmentum length 0.52/0.52—0.54/0.52; postmentum maximum width 0.23/0.23/0.23; postmentum minimum width 0.18/0.18/0.18; pronotal length 0.20/0.18—0.20/0.18; pronotal width 0.46/0.44—0.49/0.46.
